papers.title: Human iEEG recordings during audiovisual speech violations support and extend predictive routing models
papers.translated_title: 人类在视听言语违例期间的颅内脑电记录支持并扩展了预测路由模型
papers.author: Collado, J. V.
papers.summary: Rather than constantly reconstructing the world solely through sensory input, predictive processing theories posit that the brain utilizes predictions maintained as internal representations to guide sensory processing. An emerging model, predictive routing, proposes that an interplay between neuronal gamma (40-150 Hz) and alpha-beta (10-30 Hz) rhythms implements a dynamic mechanism for predictive processing. Namely, predictions enhance alpha-beta oscillations that suppress gamma activity during the processing of predicted inputs. While this model is supported by animal studies, its validity has not been fully explored within the human brain. The present study addresses this by leveraging human intracranial EEG (iEEG) recordings across superior temporal and prefrontal/premotor areas of seven presurgical epilepsy patients during an audiovisual speech paradigm. We calculated iEEG power in the theta, alpha-beta, and high gamma bands during simple auditory deviance, multisensory integration, and a condition where an incongruent visual cue (lip movements) clashed with an auditory stimulus (a syllable), creating audiovisual incongruence that can elicit the McGurk illusion. Results revealed increased high-gamma and decreased alpha-beta power in the superior temporal cortex in response to auditory deviance and the McGurk condition, while frontal areas, despite reflecting a similar decrease in alpha-beta power, did not present this high gamma prediction error signal. Instead, the theta band revealed a strong prediction error signal in the McGurk condition, consistent with theories on the role of theta in reorganizing cortical networks. These results both support and extend existing predictive routing models for human-specific forms of predictive processing.
papers.translated_summary: 预测加工理论认为，大脑并非仅通过感觉输入不断重建世界，而是利用以内部表征形式维持的预测来引导感觉加工。一个新兴模型——预测路由——提出，神经元伽马（40-150 Hz）与阿尔法-贝塔（10-30 Hz）节律之间的相互作用实现了一种预测加工的动态机制。具体而言，预测增强阿尔法-贝塔振荡，从而在处理被预测输入时抑制伽马活动。虽然该模型得到了动物研究的支持，但其在人类大脑中的有效性尚未得到充分探索。本研究通过利用七名术前癫痫患者在视听言语范式中的颅内脑电（iEEG）记录，覆盖颞上区和前额/前运动区，来探讨这一问题。我们计算了在简单听觉偏差、多感觉整合以及一种不一致视觉线索（唇动）与听觉刺激（音节）冲突并产生可诱发McGurk错觉的视听不一致条件下的theta、阿尔法-贝塔和高伽马频段iEEG功率。结果显示，在听觉偏差和McGurk条件下，颞上皮质的高伽马功率增加、阿尔法-贝塔功率降低，而额区尽管也表现出类似的阿尔法-贝塔功率降低，却未呈现这种高伽马预测误差信号。相反，theta频段在McGurk条件下显示出强烈的预测误差信号，这与关于theta在重组皮质网络中作用的理论一致。这些结果既支持又扩展了现有针对人类特异性预测加工形式的预测路由模型。

papers.title: The human-specific gene FRMPD2B couples postnatal experience to the expansion of cortical connectivity
papers.translated_title: 人类特异性基因FRMPD2B将出生后经历与皮层连接性的扩展相耦合
papers.author: Christopoulou, E.
papers.summary: The human neocortex is characterized by its uniquely prolonged postnatal developmental period during which experience sculpts neuronal circuits, a process essential to human cognitive abilities. Yet whether human-specific genetic innovations have shaped the activity-dependent mechanisms regulating circuit assembly remains unknown. Here, we identify the human-specific gene FRMPD2B as an activity- and experience-regulated modifier of cortical connectivity. FRMPD2B is primarily expressed in cortico-cortical projection neurons postnatally and throughout childhood. It promotes dendritic, axonal and synaptic development, and is required for proper morphogenesis in xenotransplanted human cortical neurons. FRMPD2B expression is bidirectionally regulated by neuronal activity and experience. This activity-responsiveness was gained after FRMPD2B arose through partial gene duplication, when a retrotransposon insertion remodeled its promoter. Our findings highlight how a series of genetic innovations have led to the emergence of a human-specific activity-regulated developmental program through which postnatal experience drives cortical connectivity expansion, linking genome evolution to human brain plasticity.
papers.translated_summary: 人类新皮层以其独特的出生后延长发育期为主要特征，在此期间经验塑造神经元回路，这一过程对人类认知能力至关重要。然而，人类特有的遗传创新是否塑造了调控回路组装的活动依赖性机制，仍属未知。在此，我们鉴定出人类特有基因FRMPD2B作为皮层连接性的活动和经验调控修饰因子。FRMPD2B主要在出生后及整个童年期表达于皮层-皮层投射神经元中。它促进树突、轴突和突触发育，并且是异种移植人皮层神经元 proper morphogenesis 所必需的。FRMPD2B的表达受神经元活动和经验的双向调控。这种活动响应性是在FRMPD2B通过部分基因复制产生之后获得的，当时一个逆转录转座子插入重塑了其启动子。我们的发现凸显了一系列遗传创新如何导致一种人类特有的活动调控发育程序的出现，通过该程序出生后经验驱动皮层连接性扩展，从而将基因组演化与人类大脑可塑性联系起来。

papers.title: Superior Frontal Gyrus Cortical Thickness Mediates the Association Between Openness to Experience and Theory of Mind: Evidence from the Human Connectome Project
papers.translated_title: 额上回皮层厚度在经验开放性与心理理论关联中的中介作用：来自人类连接组计划的证据
papers.author: Akar, B.
papers.summary: Background: Theory of mind (ToM), the capacity to infer the mental states of others, varies considerably across healthy adults. Openness to experience has been linked both to social-cognitive abilities and to thinner prefrontal cortex, but whether cortical structure statistically accounts for the association between openness and ToM is unknown. We tested whether bilateral superior frontal gyrus (SFG) cortical thickness mediates this association. Methods: Data from 1,049 healthy young adults with complete data were drawn from the Human Connectome Project. ToM was indexed by accuracy on the Heider-Simmel social animation task, openness by the NEO Five-Factor Inventory, and SFG thickness by FreeSurfer. Models adjusted for age, sex, intracranial volume and fluid intelligence; indirect effects were tested with 5,000 bootstrap resamples, and Benjamini-Hochberg false discovery rate correction was applied. Results: Openness showed a positive total effect on ToM accuracy (beta = .081, p = .009). Higher openness was associated with thinner left and right SFG (beta = -.085 and -.084), and thinner SFG with higher ToM accuracy (beta = -.082 and -.075). Indirect effects were significant (left: .0069, 95% CI [.0010, .0158]; right: .0063, 95% CI [.0007, .0146]), accounting for approximately 8.5% and 7.8% of the total effect, and remained significant after rank-based normalisation of the ceiling-affected ToM scores. Conclusions: SFG cortical thickness partially and statistically mediates the association between openness to experience and social cognition. Because the data are cross-sectional and effects are small, the findings do not establish a causal mechanism, neural efficiency or synaptic pruning, but they identify a candidate structural pathway for longitudinal testing.
papers.translated_summary: 背景：心理理论（ToM）是推断他人心理状态的能力，在健康成年人中差异很大。经验开放性既与社会认知能力相关，也与较薄的前额叶皮层相关，但皮层结构是否在统计上解释了开放性与ToM之间的关联尚不清楚。我们检验了双侧额上回（SFG）皮层厚度是否中介这一关联。方法：数据来自人类连接组计划，纳入1，049名数据完整的健康年轻成年人。ToM以Heider-Simmel社会动画任务的准确率衡量，开放性以NEO五因素量表衡量，SFG厚度以FreeSurfer测量。模型调整了年龄、性别、颅内体积和流体智力；间接效应采用5，000次自助重抽样检验，并应用Benjamini-Hochberg错误发现率校正。结果：开放性对ToM准确率呈正向总效应（beta = .081，p = .009）。较高的开放性与较薄的左侧和右侧SFG相关（beta = -.085和-.084），较薄的SFG与较高的ToM准确率相关（beta = -.082和-.075）。间接效应显著（左侧：.0069，95% CI [.0010, .0158]；右侧：.0063，95% CI [.0007, .0146]），分别约占总效应的8.5%和7.8%，且在对受天花板效应影响的ToM分数进行基于秩的正态化后仍显著。结论：SFG皮层厚度部分且在统计上中介了经验开放性与社会认知之间的关联。由于数据为横断面且效应较小，这些发现不能确立因果机制、神经效率或突触修剪，但为纵向检验确定了一条候选结构通路。

papers.title: A Unified World Model in Human Posterior Parietal Cortex
papers.translated_title: 人类后顶叶皮层中的统一世界模型
papers.author: Bougou, V.
papers.summary: How does the brain understand the physical world, predict future events, and plan actions? Are these problems solved by a unified world model, as hypothesized by cognitive scientists and artificial intelligence researchers? Posterior parietal cortex has been implicated in all these functions, but whether the same neurons support each of them is unknown. We recorded from the superior parietal lobule (SPL) of two tetraplegic participants implanted with microelectrode arrays. SPL units preferentially engaged by intuitive physics, judging block-tower stability and viewing naturalistic physical events, also predicted whether moving objects would collide hundreds of milliseconds before contact, generalizing between different physical scenarios. These populations also encoded which hand action the participant intended to perform. These findings identify SPL as a substrate for physical world modeling.
papers.translated_summary: 大脑如何理解物理世界、预测未来事件并规划行动？这些问题是否如认知科学家和人工智能研究者所假设的那样，由一个统一的世界模型来解决？后顶叶皮层被认为参与了上述所有功能，但同一群神经元是否分别支持这些功能尚不清楚。我们记录了两名植入微电极阵列的四肢瘫痪参与者的顶上小叶（SPL）。SPL单元优先参与直觉物理加工，即判断积木塔的稳定性以及观看自然istic物理事件，同时也在接触前数百毫秒预测运动物体是否会发生碰撞，并在不同物理情境之间实现泛化。这些神经元群体还编码了参与者意图执行哪只手的动作。这些发现表明SPL是物理世界建模的神经基础。

papers.title: Cortical long-range dynamics track excitation-inhibition balance across cognitive states and organizational principles
papers.translated_title: 皮层长程动力学追踪跨认知状态和组织原则的兴奋-抑制平衡
papers.author: Bisi, M.
papers.summary: A fundamental question in systems neuroscience is how the brain's excitation-inhibition (E/I) balance shapes the temporal structure of neural activity and whether we can non-invasively recover this relationship from neural scaling properties. We show that MRS-derived E/I balance is expressed in long-range temporal dynamics and constrained by cytoarchitecture. The laminar organisation of inhibitory circuits, spanning agranular to granular cortex, determines how faithfully regional dynamics reflect E/I balance. This neurochemical signature is state-dependent: its relationship with cortical dynamics reverses during task engagement, consistent with traversal of dynamical regimes around a critical point. It extends beyond fMRI to arousal-linked dynamics, indexed by pupil diameter and microsaccades, indicating a global mode of cortical state rather than a regionally isolated property. The imprint of E/I balance on long-range dynamics follows the sensory-association axis at rest, and is reconfigured during task engagement. These findings establish E/I balance as a neurochemical quantity with structured, scalable signatures across the temporal and spatial organization of the human cortex.
papers.translated_summary: 系统神经科学的一个基本问题是，大脑的兴奋-抑制（E/I）平衡如何塑造神经活动的时间结构，以及我们能否从神经尺度特性中无创地恢复这一关系。我们表明，MRS导出的E/I平衡表达于长程时间动力学中，并受细胞构筑约束。抑制性环路的层状组织，从无颗粒皮层到颗粒皮层，决定了区域动力学反映E/I平衡的忠实程度。这种神经化学特征具有状态依赖性：其与皮层动力学的关系在任务参与期间发生反转，这与围绕临界点的动力学机制遍历相一致。该特征超越fMRI，延伸至与觉醒相关的动力学，以瞳孔直径和微眼动为指标，表明其是一种全局性的皮层状态模式，而非区域孤立的属性。E/I平衡对长程动力学的印记在静息状态下遵循感觉-联合轴，并在任务参与期间被重新配置。这些发现确立了E/I平衡作为一种神经化学量，在人类皮层的时间与空间组织中具有结构化的、可扩展的特征。

papers.title: Impact of RNA modification and IL-12 boosts on mRNA-LNP vaccine-elicited CD8+ T cell responses
papers.translated_title: RNA修饰与IL-12增强对mRNA-LNP疫苗诱导的CD8+ T细胞应答的影响
papers.author: Santra, S.
papers.summary: Development of effective HIV-1 vaccines requires strategies for inducing both CD8+ T cell and neutralizing antibody responses. Nucleoside-modified mRNA-lipid-nanoparticles (LNP) induce more potent antibody responses than unmodified mRNA-LNP vaccines, while unmodified mRNA is typically employed for CD8+ T cell-inducing vaccines. Here, we compared the abilities of differing ratios of unmodified versus modified mRNA expressing a SIV conserved-region CD8+ T cell immunogen co-administered with IL-12-encoding mRNA-LNP during boosting to induce CD8+ T cell and humoral responses in non-human primates, assessing responses in ChAdOx1-primed controls in parallel. Serial priming and boosting with fully-unmodified mRNA elicited higher-magnitude, more CD8-biased T cell responses than fully-modified mRNA, that were durably maintained after the IL-12-encoding mRNA boosts. Inclusion of 30% nucleoside-modified mRNA enhanced antibody titers, suggesting potential benefits to a mixed-composition vaccine.
papers.translated_summary: 开发有效的HIV-1疫苗需要能够同时诱导CD8+ T细胞和中和抗体应答的策略。核苷修饰的mRNA-脂质纳米颗粒（LNP）比未修饰的mRNA-LNP疫苗诱导更强的抗体应答，而未修饰的mRNA通常用于诱导CD8+ T细胞的疫苗。在此，我们比较了在加强免疫期间，表达SIV保守区CD8+ T细胞免疫原的不同比例未修饰与修饰mRNA与编码IL-12的mRNA-LNP联合给药在非人灵长类中诱导CD8+ T细胞和体液应答的能力，并平行评估了ChAdOx1初免对照中的应答。连续初免和加强免疫使用完全未修饰的mRNA比完全修饰的mRNA引发了更高幅度、更偏向CD8的T细胞应答，且在编码IL-12的mRNA加强免疫后持久维持。加入30%核苷修饰的mRNA提高了抗体滴度，提示混合组成疫苗的潜在益处。

papers.title: Cross-modal transfer enables zero-shot prediction of drug responses across cell types
papers.translated_title: 跨模态迁移使跨细胞类型的药物反应零样本预测成为可能
papers.author: Luo, C.
papers.summary: Genetic perturbation responses capture the functional consequences of gene-level interventions, providing functional information for drug-response prediction beyond baseline gene expression. Within the same cellular context, genetic and chemical perturbations engage shared regulatory networks, providing a biological basis for transferring response information between perturbation modalities. Here we introduce GRAFT, a framework that combines genetic-to-chemical transfer with cross-context prediction to infer drug-induced transcriptional responses without drug measurements in the target context. Across benchmarked LINCS and external contexts, GRAFT improved response correlation, directional agreement and magnitude reconstruction over competing methods, particularly for drugs with context-dependent responses. GRAFT-Adapt further refines predictions of unmeasured responses using a small number of drug measurements from the target context. GRAFT-Atlas spans 13 cellular contexts and 7,856 drug catalog entries, comprising 102,128 predictions for drug-context combinations. The atlas captured recognizable pharmacological neighborhoods, shared functional programs, context-dependent transcriptional changes and structural-functional associations supported by molecular docking. Across ten iPSC lines from distinct donors, GRAFT identified candidate inter-donor differences, with functional support for selected candidates from measured genetic perturbation responses. Together, GRAFT enables perturbation-informed prediction and comparison of drug responses across cellular contexts.
papers.translated_summary: 遗传扰动响应捕捉基因层面干预的功能后果，为药物响应预测提供超越基线基因表达的功能信息。在同一细胞背景下，遗传扰动和化学扰动参与共享的调控网络，为在扰动模态之间转移响应信息提供了生物学基础。在此，我们提出GRAFT框架，该框架将遗传到化学的转移与跨背景预测相结合，以在目标背景中无需药物测量即可推断药物诱导的转录响应。在基准测试的LINCS和外部背景中，GRAFT在响应相关性、方向一致性和幅度重建方面优于竞争方法，特别是对于具有背景依赖性响应的药物。GRAFT-Adapt利用来自目标背景的少量药物测量进一步优化未测量响应的预测。GRAFT-Atlas涵盖13个细胞背景和7,856个药物目录条目，包含102,128个药物-背景组合的预测。该图谱捕捉了可识别的药理学邻域、共享功能程序、背景依赖性转录变化以及由分子对接支持的结构-功能关联。在来自不同供体的十个iPSC系中，GRAFT识别了候选的供体间差异，并利用测得的遗传扰动响应为选定候选提供功能支持。总之，GRAFT能够实现扰动信息驱动的预测以及跨细胞背景的药物响应比较。

papers.title: Pycea: a scverse toolkit for single-cell lineage tracing analysis
papers.translated_title: Pycea：一个用于单细胞谱系追踪分析的 scverse 工具包
papers.author: Colgan, W. N.
papers.summary: Lineage tracing enables reconstruction of cellular histories in development, regeneration, and disease, but integrating lineage data into single-cell analysis workflows remains challenging. We introduce Pycea, a Python toolkit for lineage analysis and visualization, and TreeData, an extension of AnnData that stores lineage trees alongside cellular measurements. TreeData is compatible with Scanpy and other scverse tools, enabling integrated analysis without converting between formats. Pycea provides scalable methods for tree visualization, clade identification, distance comparisons, ancestral state inference, and lineage statistics. This software is open source and available at https://github.com/YosefLab/pycea.
papers.translated_summary: 谱系追踪能够重建发育、再生和疾病中的细胞历史，但将谱系数据整合到单细胞分析工作流程中仍然具有挑战性。我们推出Pycea，一个用于谱系分析和可视化的Python工具包，以及TreeData，一个AnnData的扩展，可将谱系树与细胞测量数据一同存储。TreeData与Scanpy及其他scverse工具兼容，无需在格式之间转换即可实现整合分析。Pycea提供了可扩展的方法用于树可视化、分支鉴定、距离比较、祖先状态推断和谱系统计。该软件为开源软件，可在https://github.com/YosefLab/pycea获取。

papers.title: Homoharringtonine targets XPC to inhibit DNA damage repair and sensitize tumors to platinum-based chemotherapy
papers.translated_title: 高三尖杉酯碱靶向XPC抑制DNA损伤修复并使肿瘤对铂类化疗敏感
papers.author: Wang, C.
papers.summary: DNA damage repair (DDR) is essential for preserving genomic stability and also represents a key targetable axis in cancer drug development. Here, we identify and validate homoharringtonine (HHT), a clinically approved antileukemic drug, as a novel DDR inhibitor using a phenotype-driven, high-content screen based on 53BP1 Tudor-domain foci formation. Mechanistically, HHT directly binds XPC, a critical nucleotide excision repair (NER) factor, with high affinity (Kd = 158.4 nM) in a manner dependent on Thr795 of XPC. HHT disrupts XPC-damaged DNA binding, impairs NER, and reduces non-homologous end joining (NHEJ) efficiency. Consequently, HHT sensitizes tumor cells to platinum-based chemotherapy in vitro and in vivo. These findings establish a phenotype-based platform for DDR inhibitor discovery, identify HHT as a first-in-class XPC inhibitor and uncover a previously unrecognized mechanism of HHT that may be exploited to enhance platinum-based therapy in solid tumors.
papers.translated_summary: DNA损伤修复（DDR）对于维持基因组稳定性至关重要，也是癌症药物开发中的关键可靶向轴。在此，我们通过基于53BP1 Tudor结构域焦点形成的表型驱动高内涵筛选，鉴定并验证了临床已批准的抗白血病药物高三尖杉酯碱（HHT）作为一种新型DDR抑制剂。机制上，HHT以依赖于XPC Thr795的方式直接结合XPC——一个关键的核苷酸切除修复（NER）因子，具有高亲和力（Kd = 158.4 nM）。HHT破坏XPC与损伤DNA的结合，损害NER，并降低非同源末端连接（NHEJ）效率。因此，HHT在体外和体内使肿瘤细胞对铂类化疗敏感。这些发现建立了一个基于表型的DDR抑制剂发现平台，将HHT鉴定为首个XPC抑制剂，并揭示了HHT此前未被认识到的机制，该机制可用于增强实体瘤的铂类治疗。

papers.title: Phenotypic screening in Parkinson's iPSC-dopamine neurons identifies the FASN-SREBP1 axis as a potential therapeutic target
papers.translated_title: 帕金森病iPSC-多巴胺神经元中的表型筛选确定FASN-SREBP1轴为潜在治疗靶点
papers.author: Caiazza, M. C.
papers.summary: Parkinson's disease (PD) remains highly challenging to model in vitro, particularly when seeking robust functional phenotypes for target discovery. Patient-derived induced pluripotent stem cell dopaminergic neurons (iPSC-DANs) offer a promising platform to address this challenge. Because calcium dyshomeostasis is well-described in PD pathophysiology, it offers a platform for phenotypic screening. We have previously shown that GBA-N370S iPSC-DANs display impaired intracellular calcium release. Here, we used this disease-relevant phenotype to undertake a 4,108-compound phenotypic screen in GBA-N370S (GBA-NS) iPSC-DANs. This screen identified fatty acid synthase (FASN) as the most enriched protein target. The ability of compounds to rescue calcium release correlated with biochemical potency against FASN across multiple chemical series. We confirmed that FASN knockdown increased intracellular calcium release, supporting an on-target effect. Untargeted lipidomics demonstrated broad remodelling of the neuronal lipidome after FASN inhibition, confirming target engagement. FASN inhibition also increased active a-glucocerebrosidase (GCase), reduced extracellular a-synuclein release and ER stress, and altered RASGRF1 expression. Mechanistically, FASN inhibition activated sterol regulatory element-binding protein 1 (SREBP1), and SREBP1 overexpression alone was sufficient to increase intracellular calcium release, identifying a FASN-SREBP1-calcium homeostasis axis in human neurons. Finally, the FASN inhibitor BI 99179 achieved brain exposure and reduced brain fatty acid levels while inducing an SRE-associated transcriptional response in a Parkinson's mouse model, providing evidence of in vivo target engagement. These findings establish patient iPSC-neuron functional screening as a tractable discovery platform to identify targets which can be taken in vivo and nominate the FASN-SREBP1 axis as a candidate therapeutic pathway in PD.
papers.translated_summary: 帕金森病（PD）在体外建模仍然极具挑战性，尤其是在寻求用于靶点发现的有力功能表型时。患者来源的诱导多能干细胞多巴胺能神经元（iPSC-DANs）为解决这一挑战提供了有前景的平台。由于钙稳态失调在PD病理生理学中已被充分描述，这为表型筛选提供了平台。我们此前已证明GBA-N370S iPSC-DANs表现出细胞内钙释放受损。在此，我们利用这一与疾病相关的表型，在GBA-N370S（GBA-NS）iPSC-DANs中进行了4,108种化合物的表型筛选。该筛选鉴定出脂肪酸合酶（FASN）为最富集的蛋白靶点。化合物挽救钙释放的能力与多个化学系列中对FASN的生化效力相关。我们证实FASN敲低增加了细胞内钙释放，支持在靶效应。非靶向脂质组学证明FASN抑制后神经元脂质组发生广泛重塑，确认了靶点结合。FASN抑制还增加了活性α-葡萄糖脑苷脂酶（GCase），减少了细胞外α-突触核蛋白释放和内质网应激，并改变了RASGRF1表达。在机制上，FASN抑制激活了固醇调节元件结合蛋白1（SREBP1），而单独过表达SREBP1即足以增加细胞内钙释放，从而在人类神经元中鉴定出FASN-SREBP1-钙稳态轴。最后，FASN抑制剂BI 99179在帕金森小鼠模型中实现了脑暴露并降低了脑脂肪酸水平，同时诱导了SRE相关转录反应，提供了体内靶点结合的证据。这些发现确立了患者iPSC神经元功能筛选作为一个可操作的发现在平台，用于鉴定可在体内验证的靶点，并提名FASN-SREBP1轴作为PD的候选治疗通路。
